detail.title: Intex Titan 2000 (D) | TW 16000 FMUB 160W 2.2 Tower Speaker
detail.overview: With massive 160W power output and 36” overall driver size, the TW 16000 FMUB is your perfect companion for your parties. The music output is amazing and it also lets you host your very own Karaoke nights with 2 free mics that come along. A fully functional IR remote allows you to easily control your music. An inbuilt FM radio, informative LED display, v5.1 BT connectivity, and a USB support of 32 GB are some amazing features that you get with this speaker.
features: Driver Size Main Unit : 25.42cm (10") x 2 Mid Range Speaker : 10.16cm (4")x2 Tweeter : 10.16cm (4")x2"
Enjoy Karaoke Sessions with 2 Free Dual Cordless Mics
Control Your Music with Fully Functional IR Remote
Multi Playability of Aux, USB and Bluetooth
Analogue Control of Volume, Bass, Treble, MIC Volume, Echo knob
Rejoice the Akashvani Days with Inbuilt FM on the Go
